title: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Digitization of Rail Logistics) As defined in Article 15(2)(5) of the "Act on the Promotion and Support of the Rail Logistics Industry" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), "projects specified by a decree of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport" refers to the following projects:

1. Research and development and technical support projects related to the digitization of rail logistics.
2. Projects for standardizing and building compatible systems for the shared use of information related to rail logistics.
